jobs.title: Environmental Analyst
jobs.description:
**The Opportunity:**

Provide environmental support throughout the lifecycle of the program. Work closely with environmental subject matter experts, state, and USG environmental entities on planning, design, and construction. Design, implement, and monitor environmental control systems to maintain regulatory and company environmental standards. Apply advanced skills, extensive technical expertise, and full industry knowledge. Develop innovative solutions to complex problems. Work without considerable direction. Mentor and supervise team members.

  
  

Join us. The world can't wait.

  
  

**You Have:**

* 5+ years of experience with environmental compliance
* 5+ years of experience with NEPA analysis
* Experience supporting environmental impact assessments, site investigations, remediation projects, environmental constraints assessments, permitting activities, and conceptual site model development
* Experience using environmental information, GIS data, mapping resources, and project data to identify environmental constraints, ecological sensitivities, access considerations, and project risks
* Ability to manage competing requirements
* Ability to come up with creative and innovative solutions
* Ability to provide schedule management and development for long-term projects
* Ability to obtain a Secret clearance
* Bachelor's degree or 7+ years of experience working in the environmental field in lieu of a degree
  

**Nice If You Have:**

* Experience working environmental assessments with the USG
* Experience working environmental assessments at a USG Launch Test Range or Spaceport
* Experience working NEPA and CEQA in the State of California
* Experience analyzing monitoring, survey, laboratory, and site investigation data, preparing technical summaries and interpretations to support project decision-making
* Ability to work well in a fast-paced environment with multiple stakeholders
  

  

**Clearance:**

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.

**Compensation**

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $77,600.00 to $176,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

**Identity Statement**

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

**Candidate AI Usage Policy**

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on **your** own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited **unless permission is explicitly provided** .

  
  

**Work Model**  
Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

* **Remote** : If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.
* **Hybrid** : If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen or customer facility, in alignment with your leadership's expectations and the needs of the role.
* **Onsite** : If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed full-time at a customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.

**Commitment to Non-Discrimination**

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

jobs.title: Junior-level Multimedia Environmental Specialist
jobs.description:
**The Opportunity:**

Tetra Tech is adding a Multimedia Environmental Specialist to our Environmental Compliance team based at Edwards AFB.

**Why Tetra Tech:**

At Tetra Tech, we are Leading with Science to solve the world’s most complex challenges. Our industry-leading experts in engineering and consulting are committed to driving positive change in communities around the world. For over 50 years, we have been at the forefront of innovation and sustainability. Today we stand as a market leader, offering cutting-edge solutions in water, environment, energy, and international development. Our work has improved more than 625 million lives around the world.

**Your Impact:**

Join Tetra Tech to make a real difference. Our work leverages cutting-edge technologies, advanced analytics, and the expertise of world-class scientists and engineers to create meaningful change around the world. Discover your full potential – join us to advance your career while leaving a lasting legacy.

**Responsibilities:**

* Support Department of Defense Environmental Programs such as environmental water quality, air quality, hazardous materials, hazardous waste, solid waste, toxics, and planning.

o Support the development of EPCRA reports;  
o Support the review/update of Solid Waste compliance reports;  
o Support the review/update of Qualified Recycling Program Plan;  
o Support the review/update of SPCC Plans and tank inventories; and  
o Assist in performing inspections and administering maintenance program for landfill.  

* Conduct soil, water, and air sampling to validate the presence or absence of contaminants.

o Quarterly Sampling reports for Wastewater and solid waste programs and  
o Sampling/analysis/report development for RCRA and NPDES permit requirements.  

* Support Department of Defense and other agencies Air Quality Program to include:

o Collect, analyze, and develop reports in support of environmental programs for federal, state, and local clients;  
o Support the development of Air Emissions Inventories;  
o Assist with Title V compliance reviews;  
o Support the development of Greenhouse Gas Inventories and reporting;  
o NSR, PSD, and Title V permitting;  
o Perform EESOH-MIS VOC content reviews,  
o Supports AQ Records management through APIMS data entry;  
o Perform annual inspections, including CARB Method 9 VEE testing; and  
o Support other environmental protocols as required.  

* Performs technical writing for review/approval by senior level personnel.
* Support landfill sampling and reporting.
* Coordination with installation personnel on the scheduling of inspections and testing.
* Data review, option evaluation, applicability review, and recommendation of best results for review by senior staff.
* Support senior staff regarding client interaction and presentation of options and results.
* Assist in the production of deliverables.
* Technical report writing, data analysis and client interaction are regular requirements associated with this position. Periodically there are requirements to present project findings to a client and relevant stakeholders.
* Conduct activities in line with internal procedures, legislation, and industry standards.
* Pursue continuous professional development and maintain a high degree of discipline, knowledge, and awareness.
* Work in a safe manner at all times and report all health and safety incidents and concerns.
* Additional duties as required.

The salary range for this position is $ 70,304 - $78,000. Please note that Tetra Tech considers various factors in determining pay, including but not limited to: education, relevant and demonstrated work experience in the role, skills, geographic location, qualifications, certifications, and other competencies relevant to the needs of the business.

**Qualifications & Requirements:**  
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Included in this section are education, experience, skills (including computer skills), licenses, certificates, and registrations.

**Education & Experience:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering or related field
* 0-5 years’ experience required.
* Obtain a flight line driver’s license.

**Experience Required:**  

* Ability to work well in a team environment.
* When tasked with work, executing the work independently and within the prescribed timeframe.
* Ability to multitask and support multiple projects needs effectively and efficiently.
* Ability to interface and interact with the client in a professional manner and represent Tetra Tech.
* Working knowledge of CERCLA, EPCRA, RCRA, 40 CFR 112, Title V permitting, CAA, CWA, including permitting and emission inventories.
* Knowledge of federal, state, and local regulations related to environmental issues in the state of California.

**Experience Preferred:**  

* Permit application assembly and emission inventory development.
* Current or previous Common Access Card Holder Preferred.
* Knowledge of the Air Force data management systems such as Air Program Information Management System preferred, STAR, EESOH-MIS, WET, and eDASH.
* Knowledge of the United States Air Force or other DoD organizations preferred.
* Familiar with ISO 14001.
* Sampling and analysis, report writing, and database management.

**Skills Required:**  

* Must be able to obtain and maintain CARB Method 9 Certification.
* Must be able to obtain and maintain a flight line driver’s license.
* Excellent communications, technical report writing, fact and research finding.
* Sampling, field work, using measuring instruments, data analyses and reporting.
* Computer skills, MS Excel, Word, ACCESS, adobe.
* Must be able to obtain government security clearance an

jobs.title: D-SNP Health Risk Assessment Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Central Coast Salary Range:** $26.30 - $36.82

**Job Summary**

The HRA Coordinator is a non-licensed, non-clinical team member responsible for conducting Health Risk Assessments (HRAs) and supporting member outreach activities for Dual Eligible Special Needs Plan (D-SNP) members. This position serves as the primary resource for HRA outreach, assessment completion, risk stratification, and identification of health-related and social needs. Through telephonic outreach and standardized assessments, the HRA Coordinator identifies low-, medium-, and high-risk members and facilitates referrals to Care Coordination, Care Management, and other appropriate programs for further intervention and support. This position may provide backup support for D-SNP Care Coordinator functions as operational needs require.

**Duties & Responsibilities**

**Health Risk Assessment Administration and Member Outreach, with duties including but not limited to:**

* Conduct telephonic Health Risk Assessments with D-SNP members and authorized representatives.
* Complete initial and annual HRAs within established regulatory and organizational timeframes.
* Perform inbound and outbound member outreach to schedule and complete assessments.
* Explain the purpose and benefits of the HRA process and encourage member participation.
* Gather and document information related to health status, chronic conditions, medications, healthcare utilization, behavioral health, functional limitations, caregiver support, and social needs.
* Verify member eligibility, demographic and contact information.
* Utilize approved assessment tools, workflows, scripts, and department protocols.
* Establish rapport and maintain professional interactions with members, caregivers, providers, and internal stakeholders.
* Utilize interpreter services as needed to effectively communicate with members.
* Maintain assigned outreach inventories and assessment workloads to meet productivity standards.

**2. Risk Stratification and Needs Identification, with duties including but not limited to:**

* Review HRA findings to identify health risks, barriers to care, and unmet member needs.
* Stratify members into low-, medium-, and high-risk categories utilizing established departmental criteria.
* Evaluate assessment findings to identify member risk levels, health-related needs, functional limitations, behavioral health concerns, and social determinants of health (SDOH) barriers.
* Identify opportunities for intervention through Care Coordination, Care Management, Social Work, Community Health Workers, Pharmacy, Behavioral Health, LTSS, and other supportive programs.
* Assess for social determinants of health concerns including food insecurity, transportation barriers, housing instability, caregiver support needs, and access to healthcare services.
* Recognize indicators of frequent emergency department utilization, recent hospitalizations, chronic disease burden, medication concerns, functional impairments, behavioral health needs, and fall risk.
* Identify members requiring additional assessment or clinical review.
* Prioritize referrals based on risk level and member needs.
* Communicate significant findings to appropriate care team members.

**3. Referral Management and Care Coordination Support, with duties including but not limited to:**

* Generate referrals to Care Coordination, Care Management, Social Work, Community Health Workers, Behavioral Health, and other internal programs based on assessment findings.
* Facilitate referrals to community-based organizations and supportive services.
* Transfer identified members to the appropriate care team for ongoing engagement and intervention.
* Collaborate with Care Coordinators, RN Care Managers, Social Workers, and other interdisciplinary team members to ensure smooth member transitions.
* Escalate urgent clinical, safety, behavioral health, abuse, neglect, or other high-risk concerns according to established policies and procedures.
* Monitor assigned referral activities and support closure of referral loops when appropriate.
* Assist with member outreach, scheduling, appointment coordination, and other non-clinical care coordination activities as assigned.
* Provide backup support for D-SNP Care Coordinator responsibilities during staffing shortages, peak workloads, or operational needs.

**4. Documentation, Reporting, and Quality Support, with duties including but not limited to:**

* Accurately document member interactions, outreach efforts, HRA findings, and referral activities in designated systems.
* Ensure timely and complete data entry in accordance with departmental standards.
* Maintain confidentiality and protect member information in compliance with HIPAA and organizational policies.
* Monitor assigned work queues and complete tasks within established turnaround times.
* Assist with audit preparation, reporting activities, and quality review processes.
* Monitor HRA completion rates and support initiatives designed to improve member outreach and engagement.
* Participate in team meetings, trainings, and quality improvement activities.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Knowledge/Skills/Abilities**

* **Member Engagement and Communication:** Demonstrates strong verbal communication skills, active listening, professionalism, and the ability to build rapport with members telephonically.
* **Language Proficiency:** Fluent in both English and Spanish with the ability to effectively communicate with members, caregivers, providers, and community partners in both languages. Able to conduct telephonic Health Risk Assessments, explain health plan benefits and programs, obtain accurate member information, and document interactions appropriately.
* **Health Risk Assessment Administration:** Ability to accurately administer standardized assessments, gather comprehensive information, and document findings.
